articles.title: Tecno set to launch Spark 50 5G smartphone on March 27 with Pixel 10-inspired design
articles.description: Tecno is all set to launch the new Spark 50 5G smartphone on March 27 in India. The new smartphone features a Pixel 10-inspired rear design and MIL-STD-810H certification. On top of this, it has a large 6,500 mAh battery with 45 W wired charging support.
